name: Jest of the Dying Plain
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target can only use free, swift, or immediate actions until the end of your next turn.
